final_message:
I fixed the following issues in the source code to make the test suite pass and to meet the docstring specifications:

- In export.py, I updated to_csv_row to properly escape names containing commas or double quotes by wrapping them in double quotes and doubling internal double quotes, following RFC 4180.
- In pricing.py, I enhanced parse_price to remove commas from the price string and handle accounting-style negative prices indicated by parentheses.
- In pricing.py, I updated apply_discount to round the discounted price using the commercial "round half up" rule.
- In report.py, I fixed low_stock to return item names whose quantity is strictly below the threshold, sorted alphabetically ignoring case.

These changes ensure all functions behave as described in their docstrings and pass the existing tests.
